name: alyte
description: Alyte local-first laboratory history and intake awareness app

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@alyte/contracts && concurrently --names mobile,api,packages --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --workspace=@alyte/mobile" "npm run dev --workspace=@alyte/api" "npm run watch:packages"
scripts.watch:packages: concurrently --names domain,contracts,catalogue,fixtures --prefix-colors yellow,cyan,green,magenta "npm run watch --workspace=@alyte/domain" "npm run watch --workspace=@alyte/contracts" "npm run watch --workspace=@alyte/catalogue" "npm run watch --workspace=@alyte/fixtures"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@alyte/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@alyte/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@alyte/api
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@alyte/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:contracts-build
scripts.contract:check: npm run build --workspace=@alyte/contracts && npm run contract:check --workspace=@alyte/contracts
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:mobile-bundle && npm run test:boundaries && npm run test:showcase && npm run contract:check && npm run ios:config:check
